execution_gate.pre_registered_on: 2026-07-28, at the opening of BATCH-010 and before any contract is frozen
execution_gate.rule_1: BATCH-010 MAY NOT CLOSE without at least one committed run record carrying a complete manifest. A close without one is recorded as a BATCH FAILURE with its cause, never as a research result and never as evidence about H-STR-002.
execution_gate.rule_2: A REVISE verdict on the EXP-STR-004 contract permits AT MOST ONE amendment cycle - one versioned protocol_amendment, one snapshot, one independent re-review, dispatched under a recorded queue amendment as TASK-20260728-024 and TASK-20260728-025. After that cycle the batch either executes the reduced-scope core or records the non-execution as a BATCH FAILURE.
execution_gate.rule_3: A REJECT verdict ends the batch immediately as a batch failure with its cause recorded. It does not authorize a second design.
execution_gate.why: The next batch must execute is an intention, and BATCH-006 shows what happens to intentions on this route: EXP-IC-002 went REVISE, versioned amendment, independent re-review, and never executed. Three of the last four batches measured nothing. A gate is checkable; a resolution is not.
execution_gate.what_this_gate_is_not: It is NOT a licence to execute a defective contract in order to satisfy the gate. If the contract cannot be executed as frozen, the Executor stops and reports, and the batch fails honestly. An executed-but-invalid run set is not evidence either.
execution_gate.infrastructure_carve_out: A timeout, crash or cap hit during execution is INFRASTRUCTURE SIGNAL and is never negative evidence about H-STR-002. It does, however, count against this gate: the gate is about whether the campaign measures anything, not about what the measurement says.

required_controls.title: Relation-freeness screen with a threshold
required_controls.status_in_this_batch: CARRIED, NOT DISCHARGED, AND NOT APPLICABLE TO EXP-STR-004
required_controls.description: For any candidate eigenvalue tuple, compute the first minimum of the relation lattice R_r and compare it with X = ceil(N^(1/(2r))); the cell is genuine iff no relation of infinity norm at most X exists. This replaces a rank count with the invariant that actually governs the phenomenon. It is the standing genuine/synthetic criterion for any FUTURE contract in the endomorphism lane and is recorded in KN-FIND-002. Nobody has run it on a curve-backed alternative triple, and BATCH-010 does not, because EXP-STR-004 is in a different lane.

required_controls.title: Baseline-position statement inside every frozen contract
required_controls.description: Before freezing, every contract states its algorithm's position against Pollard rho, BSGS and the closest specialized baseline, in TIME AND MEMORY, at the declared sizes. BATCH-009 froze a contract whose Pareto domination was already recorded in its own source proposal's tradeoff_note; a criterion-feasibility table checks thresholds against cells and would not have caught it.

batch_opening_decision.reserved_ledger_id_status: RESERVED AND UNWRITTEN. This block is a COORDINATION RECORD, NOT A LEDGER RECORD, following the precedent of the BATCH-009 batch_opening_decision. DEC-20260728-002 is written by TASK-20260728-023 after all three independent reviews report, and it carries both this opening rationale and the official disposition of the result.
batch_opening_decision.context: BATCH-009 closed with DEC-20260728-001: a scoped rejection of EXP-ENDO-001 prediction P2 on the frozen J0 eigenvalue source, backed by a level-1 counterexample certificate, together with eight retractions of the Coordinator's own published reasoning. EXP-ENDO-001 v1 is withdrawn before execution and ZERO RUNS EXIST. Nine batches have produced no candidate attack improvement reproduced or proved within scope and no independently validated novel technique; three of the last four measured nothing. Both hypotheses this goal has carried remain `weakened`, all four promotion gates remain OPEN, and the ledger still does not validate.
rationale: THE REPLICATION OBLIGATION IS NOW DUE, AND IT IS MANDATORY RATHER THAN DISCRETIONARY. DEC-20260727-002 weakened H-STR-002 on an `empirical_only` basis. DEFER-BATCH009-001 records that the replication EXP-STR-004 discharges is BINDING on the next transition of H-STR-002 in either direction. BATCH-009 proposed no such transition and could therefore defer it; a campaign that keeps deferring it while the hypothesis sits weakened is carrying an undischarged obligation, and the obligation is the reason for this opening.

ITS FAILURE MODE IS MEASUREMENT RATHER THAN DESIGN. The arms are already specified in the committed resume action, the compute is low, the driver is a two-line change to a copy of an append rule, and the sharp prediction alpha = 0 at every instance with B mod 3 == 0 has a genuinely available failing outcome. It can produce an uninformative result; it is not the kind of contract that turns out to be unexecutable.

TARGET-CLASS IS EXPRESSLY NOT THE CRITERION, AND SAYING OTHERWISE WOULD BE INCONSISTENT. DEFER-BATCH009-001 itself records that this lane's only reproducible effect is a constant factor of 2.62 to 3.20x, which rule A1 places outside target class, and that its best outcome adjudicates an instrument and cannot move an exponent in either direction. The criterion that killed EXP-ENDO-001 would disqualify this opening too. Adopted from RT-20260728-002 S6 and recorded rather than glossed.

THE BATCH DECIDES A QUESTION ABOUT THE CAMPAIGN FOR FREE. EXP-STR-004's decisive quantities are SAMPLED. If a sampled-quantity contract also fails to execute, the selection-bias explanation of three-of-four batches measuring nothing is falsified on its own terms and the stopped-harness explanation takes over. That is declared as a second purpose, and RC-8 makes it checkable.

THE PROCESS HARDENING IS APPLIED HERE RATHER THAN DEFERRED AGAIN. DEFER-BATCH009-003's criterion feasibility table, RC-7's baseline-position statement and RC-8's labels are all binding on the freeze card, and RC-9 gates the close. The BATCH-009 diagnosis - a threshold pre-registered without being evaluated at the cells that would run - is corrected by the table; the deeper defect it missed, freezing a design whose baseline position was already recorded in its own proposal, is corrected by RC-7.
batch_opening_decision.what_this_opening_does_not_do: It does not retract, cancel or discharge anything. It does not assert that the phi_alpha instrument question is settled - it is UNADJUDICATED and no record may call the metric either an artifact or a validated measurement. It does not change any hypothesis status: H-STR-002 stays `weakened` per DEC-20260727-002, H-IC-001 stays `weakened` per DEC-20260727-001, and H-ENDO-001 stays `approved`. It asserts no target-class ambition and no completion criterion is reachable under any outcome.
limitations: No hypothesis status changes by this opening, and no outcome of this batch meets a completion criterion of GOAL-ECDLP-001.

Toy tier only, at most 28 field bits, one Python implementation, one machine. No attack improvement, no cryptographic evidence, no closure, no impossibility claim and no crypto-scale validation under any outcome.
NOTHING IN THIS LANE IS TARGET-CLASS. Its ceiling is a constant factor, and no asymptotic exponent moves in either direction. All four promotion gates remain OPEN and are not addressed.
This contract adjudicates an INSTRUMENT. It can neither establish nor refute the MECHANISM of H-STR-002, and no record produced under this queue may say otherwise.
